title: The 13 Best Waffle Makers of 2026
metaDescription: Our 13 picks for waffle makers of 2026, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at waffle makers of 2026 using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Breville BWM520XL No-Mess Waffle Maker
products.blurb: Key specs: No-mess overflow moat around the plate perimeter, 5-position browning dial, 1-inch deep Belgian pockets.
strengths: No-mess moat eliminates counter and hinge cleanup that every budget model in this category suffers from
5-position browning dial gives the widest and most precise browning range of any model here
Even heat distribution across the plate avoids the edge-brown-faster problem common on cheaper irons
limitations: Fixed, non-removable plates mean cleanup after the moat is wiping rather than dishwasher washing
Single-waffle output is slower than double-plate models for feeding more than two people
features: No-mess overflow moat around the plate perimeter

products.name: Cuisinart WAF-F20P1 Double Belgian Waffle Maker
products.blurb: Key specs: Dual 7-inch Belgian waffle plates cook two waffles per cycle, Removable, dishwasher-safe plates, 6-position browning dial.
strengths: Double-plate output cuts batch time roughly in half versus any single-waffle iron in this list
Removable dishwasher-safe plates are the easiest cleanup method of any model compared here
6-position browning dial matches the Breville's control while producing two waffles at once
limitations: No overflow moat, so batter that escapes the plates drips onto the counter
Large dual-iron footprint takes up significantly more counter and storage space than single-plate models
Heavier at 6.5 lb, making it less convenient to store vertically than compact single irons
features: Dual 7-inch Belgian waffle plates cook two waffles per cycle

products.name: Oster Belgian Waffle Maker CKSTWF2000
products.blurb: Key specs: Round 1-inch deep pocket design, Ready indicator light, Cool-touch side handles.
strengths: Round plate shape gives more even edge-to-edge browning than square budget models
Compact size and vertical storage clip fit easily in small kitchens
Delivers genuine 1-inch Belgian pocket depth at roughly a third of the Breville's price
limitations: Single fixed heat setting, so there's no way to dial back browning for a lighter waffle
No overflow containment, unlike the moat on the Breville
Non-stick plates aren't removable, limiting cleanup to wiping

products.name: Hamilton Beach Belgian Waffle Maker 26030

strengths: Upright storage clip saves cabinet space versus flat single-waffle irons
Simple single-switch operation means nothing to learn before the first use
limitations: No adjustable browning control, one fixed heat setting limits crispiness control
Non-stick coating wears faster than pricier models, with sticking reported after 1-2 years
No overflow moat, so overfilled batter drips onto the counter

Browning dial gives more control than the single fixed setting on cheaper Belgian irons
limitations: Thin pockets hold less topping volume than Belgian-depth models in this category
Non-removable plates limit cleanup to wiping
Single round-waffle output is slower for groups than double-plate models like the Cuisinart WAF-F20P1
features: Round classic thin-waffle design, roughly 0.5-inch pockets

products.name: All-Clad WD700162 Belgian Waffle Maker

Smallest review base and lowest rating among the full-size models in this category
